notes: ACCESS: robots.txt at fenwick.co.uk (canonical host; www.fenwick.co.uk 301-redirects there) allows User-agent: * Allow: / with no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow, so tier (a) direct HTTP was permitted. Tier (a) curl+bs4-style fetch retrieved the mega-menu (homepage HTML), robots.txt, sitemap.xml and both sitemap_collections_*.xml files, and confirmed every candidate collection's sub-navigation strip and canonical URL - all structural/nav data is server-rendered. However the product COUNT (data-show-count span, e.g. 'Showing 20 of 267 items') is populated client-side by JS after hydration and was empty in raw HTML on every collection page tested, so tier (a) alone could not get exact qty. Escalated to tier (b): Playwright headless chromium (domcontentloaded + wait_for_selector on the count element) rendered each leaf collection page once and read the hydrated count text plus h1/canonical for confirmation. No block encountered at either tier; tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. TREE: this is a large Shopify storefront (55 product sitemaps). Company is a UK department store; treated the 'Home & Tech' mega-menu department as the Home & Furniture equivalent (per task scope) and did not wander into Fashion/Beauty/Women/Men/Bags departments. Also checked the adjacent 'Furniture & Outdoor' department nav - it is 100% furniture/outdoor-furniture sub-nav (Garden Furniture, Living/Dining/Office/Bedroom Furniture, brand pages) with no textile/storage-specific nodes, so nothing from it qualified. Also checked 'Kids' department - it has a Nursery>Bedding node that is technically home textile, but the whole department is a clothing/fashion department per the brief's department-scoping instruction, so it was excluded as out of scope (flagged below rather than silently dropped). Within Home & Tech, built the full tree as the union of mega-menu (Bedroom, Bathroom, Home Furnishings & Accessories, Kitchen/Cooking, Dining branches) and the sitemap_collections files (which revealed the deeper leaf handles, e.g. home-and-tech-bedroom-bed-linen-duvet-covers/-pillowcases/-sheets, and home-and-tech-bathroom-towels-bath-towels/-hand-towels/-face-towels, that are only exposed via each parent collection page's own in-page 'collection-sub-navigation' strip, not the top mega-menu). Per rule 25/34 (parent-URL rule), parent nodes with valid subcategories (Bed Linen, Towels, Bathroom Accessories, Utility & Textiles, Food Preparation & Storage, Tableware & Cutlery) were recorded as grouping rows only; their leaf children carry the qty/link. QTY: exact number taken from the hydrated 'Showing X of TOTAL items' text on each leaf's own collection page (TOTAL used), evidence string records the exact text and h1 confirming canonical/h1 match. EXCLUDED (checked and rejected): 'Bedroom Accessories' - inspected actual product links (blanket, hot-water-bottle-cover, laundry basket, cushion) and it is a genuine mixed-type catch-all with no single primary product type, not cleanly Textile or Storage, so dropped entirely rather than force it into either array. 'Laundry & Ironing' - inspected products: overwhelmingly ironing boards/covers/felt underlays (appliance/furniture, explicitly excluded by storage.md 11) plus a single laundry basket already captured separately under Bathroom Accessories>Laundry Baskets, so the category itself was not recorded. 'Placemats & Coasters' - inspected products: mostly cork/vegan-leather coasters and ribbed placemats of non-fabric material, not clearly a textile product per the material rule (textile.md 16/17), so excluded (LOW-confidence judgment call, no row forced). 'Food Preparation' (parent, non-storage siblings: canisters/jars, chopping boards, measuring, mixing bowls, sieves, utensils) and all Cookware/Bakeware/Kitchen Utensils/Dining Glassware/Barware/Tea&Coffee Drinkware/Tableware(bowls,cutlery,plates,serving trays)/Electricals/Travel/Lighting/Games & Stationery/Home Fragrance & Candles/Wall Art & Frames/Decorative Accessories/Clocks/Mirrors/Feature Books/Vases & Ornaments nodes were reviewed and excluded as Kitchen & Dining, Decorative Accessories, Wall Decor, Lighting, or unrelated per the two rule files' boundary sections. Brand-only collections (Fenwick at Home, Ralph Lauren Home, BOSS Home, Joseph Joseph, etc.), 'New In', 'Sale', and seasonal/promotional collections (Autumn Homeware, Gathered for Autumn, etc.) were excluded as View-All/Collection/promotional pages, not standard category nodes.
